description: For any propositional theory \(\Gamma\) and formula \(C\), \(\Gamma\models C\) if and only if \(\Gamma\cup\{\neg C\}\) is unsatisfiable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.entails_iff_negation_unsatisfiable.{u} {α : Type u}
  [_atomDecidable : DecidableEq α] (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory α)
  (C : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.TheoryEntails Γ C ↔
    ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.TheorySatisfiable (insert C.neg Γ)
